question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**witnessed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the experience of encountering a potential accident.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate seeing or observing the event.
 
• "**Witnessed**" fits well as it means to see or observe an event, which aligns with the context of describing an experience of almost facing an accident.
 
• Other options ("**anticipated**", "**checked**", "**argued**") do not fit the context of describing the observation of an event.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *It is the mad* *craze__* *for speed that is responsible for many motor accidents. Only last year, I* *__witnessed__* *what might have been a* **_________***accident on Kashmir Road. I was motoring down* **________***Srinagar; and as I was nearing Kohala, I came upon the* *________* *of two cars on the road.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Anticipated (अपेक्षित): "Anticipated" means expected or predicted, which does not fit the context of describing an observation of an event.
 
• Checked (जाँचा गया): "Checked" means examined, which does not align with the context of witnessing an event.
 
• Argued (तर्क किया): "Argued" means engaged in a heated discussion, which does not fit the idea of seeing an accident.
